Original is 1200x960 half-length; saved photos/rebecca-noecker.jpg as a 750x860 head-and-shoulders crop (no upscaling), full frame kept as photos/rebecca-noecker.full.jpg. david-kustoff.publisher: U.S. House of Representatives (House Creative Services), via Wikimedia Commons
david-kustoff.notes: David Kustoff, U.S. Representative, Tennessee's 8th District. His 2023 official House portrait (House Creative Services; the same photo the House Clerk member page uses), full size 2100x2625 kept as photos/david-kustoff.full.jpg; photos/david-kustoff.jpg is a head-and-shoulders crop (box 284,66,1750,1903), face ~760px across. Posed, front-facing, broad toothy smile with brows raised and eyes wide open: that is his usual expression (his 2017 portrait has the same), so draw it as the photo has it and do not exaggerate it into a caricature. Short dark hair, salt-and-pepper, graying at the temples and sides, slightly tousled on top; hazel-green eyes; no glasses; clean-shaven, light five-o'clock shadow; long narrow face with a prominent nose and visible smile lines; fair/light olive skin, even studio light. Black suit, white shirt, red tie, House member pin; US flag and blue backdrop (drop them). Rejected: the bioguide 450x550 (unitedstates.github.io K000392; his 2017 half-length photo with hands clasped on a desk, head only ~150px; kept as photos/david-kustoff.bioguide.jpg); Commons File:Kustoff_Official_Headshot.jpg (2017, older).

steven-otis.license: © New York State Assembly, used as a drawing reference
steven-otis.notes: Posed portrait from the masthead of his September 2018 Assembly newsletter (official Assembly PDF); extracted from the PDF (CMYK image, inverted and converted to RGB JPEG). The same photo was his Assembly directory headshot until about 2022 (archived headshot/091.jpg, only 134x200), so the photo itself probably dates from about 2012. Outdoors at dusk by Long Island Sound (water and a low shoreline behind), front-facing, broad smile showing teeth, eyes slightly crinkled, medium-brown hair with grey at the temples, no glasses, clean-shaven, fair skin with a ruddy, warm cast from the evening light. Dark suit, white-and-blue striped button-down shirt, navy tie with small dots. Face is about 165px across (the largest posed copy found). He is greyer now: the current Assembly directory headshot (headshot/091.jpg, 440x491, 2022) and newsletter mastheads since 2022 are a mid-word candid at a microphone on the Assembly floor, with full grey hair, so they were rejected under the posed-first rule. Nothing on Commons or Wikipedia; Ballotpedia and Vote Smart block scripts.

angelia-williams-graves.license: © Virginia House of Delegates, used as a drawing reference
angelia-williams-graves.notes: House member photo from her years as Delegate for the 90th District (2021 to Jan 2024), from the old virginiageneralassembly.gov member page (id H0331) via the Wayback Machine (Dec 2022 captures); no EXIF date, and she may look a little younger here than now. Studio headshot on a gray gradient backdrop, front-facing, big smile showing teeth (small gap between the front teeth), red lipstick. Chin-to-shoulder-length straight dark brown/black bob with soft flipped ends and a side part; dark brown eyes, defined brows, smoky eye makeup; medium-brown skin, even studio light. Black textured collarless jacket over a red top, large pearl necklace and pearl stud earrings. Face ~650px across; no glasses in this photo. Rejected: her current Senate member photo (apps.senate.virginia.gov/Senator/images/member_photos/Williams%20Graves21, id S130) is a lovely posed smiling portrait between the US and Virginia flags, but it is only 262x269 (face ~105px), and every Wayback copy is the same small size; it shows her now wearing red/burgundy oval-rectangular glasses and longer, wavier shoulder-length brown hair, in a royal blue top with pearls. Caucus page (vasenatedems.com/about-us) has the same Senate shot at 300x300. Commons only has a 199x266 crop of a USACE event candid. Her House page on house.vga.virginia.gov (H0331) is gone and was never archived.

irene-shin.license: © Virginia House of Delegates, used as a drawing reference
irene-shin.notes: Current House member-page photo for Irene Shin (District 8), edited Oct 2024. Served at 1200x1680 (seated at her desk in the House chamber, holding open a bill, half-length); photos/irene-shin.jpg is a head-and-shoulders crop (1200x1060), full frame kept as photos/irene-shin.full.jpg. Posed, face to camera, warm smile showing teeth, coral-pink lipstick. Long voluminous dark brown hair with caramel/honey balayage, curled at the ends, falling past the shoulders, slight side part; dark brown eyes; light skin with warm undertone; bright window light from behind-right plus soft fill. Black blazer over a black top, gold drop earrings with a small cross/flower charm, House lapel pin. Face ~380px across.

holly-seibold.license: © Virginia House of Delegates, used as a drawing reference
holly-seibold.notes: Current House member-page photo for Holly M. Seibold (District 12; in office since Jan 2024), 2735x3415, head and shoulders to mid-chest; no EXIF date. Studio portrait on a mottled charcoal-gray painted backdrop, front-facing, broad smile showing teeth, pink lip gloss. Straight shoulder-length blonde hair (ash/honey blonde with darker roots at the center part), blue-gray eyes, fair skin, soft even studio light. Charcoal tweed blazer over a pale aqua V-neck blouse, House lapel pin. Face ~950px across.

sandy-pappas.license: © Minnesota Senate, used as a drawing reference
sandy-pappas.notes: The Senate's official member portrait (EXIF Jan. 23, 2023), shown on her current member page (mem_id 1046; the mem_id 1052 in our yaml is a former member's 'no longer a member' page). Posed, front-facing studio headshot on gray, broad smile showing teeth, eyes visible and crinkled. Face ~650px across. Plum blazer over a black top, black-white-and-red patterned scarf, small loon pin on her left lapel. No other candidates needed.

maria-isa-perez-vega.license: © Minnesota House of Representatives, used as a drawing reference
maria-isa-perez-vega.notes: The House's official member portrait (EXIF Nov. 10, 2022), the full-size version linked from her current profile (profile 15574; the 15513 in our yaml is not her current page). Light-medium tan skin with a few freckles, soft even studio light. Cat-eye glasses with pink-glitter and silver-glitter upper rims and thin gold wire (keep them), red lipstick, large twisted gold hoop earrings. nathalia-fernandez.license: © New York State Senate, used as a drawing reference
nathalia-fernandez.notes: Official Senate studio portrait used as the page hero on her member page (same shoot as the member photo 12-27-22_fernandez-hs.jpg, so taken December 2022; that file is only 338x400 with a smaller face). nysenate.gov serves a Cloudflare challenge to scripts, so the page was read from the Wayback snapshot web.archive.org/web/20261021120256/... and the file retrieved from the Wayback Machine. Burgundy blazer over a white top, NY Senate pin. Face is about 175px across. The right third of the hero is extended plain grey background. Alternative not used: Commons File:NF_headshhot_2.jpg (2018 campaign headshot by Dtragni, CC BY-SA 4.0, 1786x1901, face ~430px, outdoor street, big smile, black blazer over navy top) is larger but older and lower tier.

sarah-clark.license: © New York State Assembly, used as a drawing reference
sarah-clark.notes: Official Assembly portrait, the cut-out header headshot on her member page (PNG with transparent background, flattened onto white and saved as JPEG). The directory headshot (headshot/136.jpg, 771x1080) is the same shoot on a blue studio backdrop with a U.S. flag, but the face is smaller there (~215px vs ~290px here). steven-raga.notes: Assembly directory headshot (uploaded Jan. 2023 when he took office), studio backdrop in mottled blue with a U.S. flag at left. Front-facing, slight head tilt, smile showing upper teeth, shaved/bald head, full short dark beard and moustache, dark brown eyes, no glasses, medium tan (Filipino American) skin, soft even light. christie-new-craig.license: © Christie New Craig, used as a drawing reference
christie-new-craig.notes: Same portrait the Senate of Virginia uses on her member page (apps.senate.virginia.gov/Senator/memberpage.php?id=S118, photo member_photos/Craig19), but the Senate serves it only at 262x269 (face ~100px) and every Wayback copy is that small, so the full-size file from her campaign home page is used (shown there cropped to a square). terrance-cole.publisher: U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration, via Wikimedia Commons
terrance-cole.notes: Terrance (Terry) Cole, Administrator of the DEA. His official DEA portrait (dated July 23, 2025, the day he took office; Commons credits dea.gov/about/dea-leadership), full size 2400x3000 kept as photos/terrance-cole.full.jpg; photos/terrance-cole.jpg is a head-and-shoulders crop (box 400,0,2000,2000), face ~850px across. Posed, front-facing, lips closed with a calm, neutral expression (no smile in his official portrait; draw it as the photo has it, relaxed rather than stern: do not add a frown or harden the brows). Fully shaved bald head; dark brown eyebrows; brown eyes; neatly trimmed salt-and-pepper goatee with mustache, mostly gray/white at the chin and darker at the mustache; no glasses; light olive/tan skin with some forehead lines, even studio light. Navy suit, white shirt, navy tie with white stars and red stripes, DEA lapel pin, flag pocket square; US flag and gray backdrop (drop them). dea.gov and getsmartaboutdrugs.gov return Akamai 'Access Denied' to our agent (robots.txt included) and the Wayback Machine was offline, so the Commons copy of the DEA portrait was used. Considered: Commons File:Terry_Cole.jpg (White House, Feb 2025, Oval Office snapshot with a faint closed-mouth smile, 876x1163 but soft and over-sharpened, phone quality) and File:S2_Meets_With_Terry_Cole (meeting candid); the official studio portrait is the best photo of him.

wren-williams.license: © Virginia House of Delegates, used as a drawing reference
wren-williams.notes: Current House member-page photo for Wren M. Williams (District 47). Served as a 1579x1063 PNG despite the .jpg name; Wayback shows this file replaced a small older photo between Oct 2025 and Feb 2026, so it is a 2026 portrait. Wide landscape frame (seated at a desk, hands clasped, small US flag at right), so photos/wren-williams.jpg is a head-and-shoulders crop (800x830) and the full frame is kept as photos/wren-williams.full.jpg. Short light-brown/dark-blond hair, short on the sides and swept up in front; dark rectangular glasses; blue eyes; fair skin with a pinkish tone, clean-shaven; warm indoor light with landscape paintings behind. Navy suit, light blue shirt, burgundy tie with a small white pattern, House lapel pin. Face ~300px across (the largest copy found). Rejected: Commons File:Virginia_Delegate_Wren_Williams.jpg (CC0, Jan 2025, 830x1503) is a phone snapshot in an office, smiling but softer, and shows him with a short full beard; the official 2026 portrait is the posed one and is clean-shaven.

amy-brendmoen.license: © Amy Brendmoen, used as a drawing reference
amy-brendmoen.notes: Former Ward 5 Council Member and Council President (2012-2023). Her own bio photo from the home page of her consulting site (alt text 'Amy Brendmoen bio photo', uploaded May 2024). The file is 1825x2560 three-quarter length (hands on hips in front of an ornate door); saved photos/amy-brendmoen.jpg as a 930x1080 head-and-shoulders crop (no upscaling), full frame kept as photos/amy-brendmoen.full.jpg. Posed, facing the camera with a slight head tilt, warm closed-mouth smile, eyes clearly visible. Face ~380px across; the file is a little soft. Short tousled pixie cut, ash-brown with blond highlights swept to one side. Fair skin, warm natural light. Small pearl stud earrings. No glasses. Black ribbed V-neck sweater. Leave the door grille background out. Her best official photo is photos/amy-brendmoen.official.jpg: the city's 2015 council portrait (Wayback, stpaul.gov ward-5 page through Dec. 2023, file 20150323-SAP_6276-Edit_0.jpg), posed on a gray backdrop with a smile, short brown hair, rust sweater and silver statement necklace, but only 267x400 with a ~120px face and 9 years older, so the larger recent press photo was preferred (precedent: Hochul, Boysko). No Commons category for her. Other rejects on her site: pink-dress photo leaning on a brick wall (428x640, small), podium and group photos.

james-bowles.publisher: VCU Libraries, Goochland County Rosenwald Schools Oral History Project (video still)
james-bowles.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (Brian J. Daugherity, Alyce Miller, Christopher Silvent; acknowledgment of VCU Libraries required), used as a drawing reference
james-bowles.notes: HOLD: the only image is a ~75px face from an overexposed 400x226 interview video; drawing it would need upscaling. Dr. James Harold Bowles (1921-2019), Goochland District 2 supervisor 1972-2004. No official, Commons or press photo found. Frame at ~0:40 of "James Bowles interview 1 (2013-10-04)", the VCU Libraries oral-history video on its Scholars Compass page (he was 92). The stream is only 400x226; photos/james-bowles.full.jpg is the whole frame and photos/james-bowles.jpg a 220x226 head-and-shoulders crop. Face only ~75px across: draw from an upscale. Seated, facing the camera with a slight turn to his left, eyes open, gentle closed-mouth smile (chosen from ~70 sampled frames; most others are mid-word). Bald on top with a thin fringe of short white hair at the sides, large ears, thin gold wire-rimmed glasses, clean-shaven, light complexion with a warm pink tone in this frame (the video is overexposed by warm window light from the right, which washes out skin tone; he was African American, per the collection's subject headings), white short-sleeved shirt and light-blue patterned bow tie, beige wall behind. The preview.jpg on the page (400x225) is a similar frame. Tried: Goochland County site (no former-supervisor photos), Commons (none), news/obituary searches (HJR906 of 2019 has no photo); the 174 MB original MP4 download (cgi/viewcontent.cgi) sits behind a Cloudflare challenge, not bypassed; Find a Grave disallows AI agents in robots.txt and its Bowles memorial found was a different man. Interview 2 (goo_items/4, 2014-01-31) streams at the same 400x226.

sean-ryan.license: © New York State Senate, used as a drawing reference
sean-ryan.notes: Official Senate member-page headshot (the 4:3 photo on his page; file dated 01-20-21, so a January 2021 studio shot). He left the Senate when he became Mayor of Buffalo in January 2026, so the page is the Wayback snapshot of his member page (nysenate.gov/senators/sean-m-ryan, the URL in his yaml 404s); the file was retrieved from the Wayback Machine copy of the original. Studio portrait on a grey backdrop with a U.S. flag at left, front-facing, relaxed closed-mouth smile showing a little of the upper teeth, eyes slightly squinted with smile lines, short grey hair (lighter grey on top, receding at the temples), blue eyes, clean-shaven, no glasses, fair skin with visible forehead and cheek lines, even studio light. Grey pinstripe suit, pink shirt, burgundy tie, NY Senate lapel pin. Face is about 1350px across.

lindsey-port.license: © Minnesota Senate, used as a drawing reference
lindsey-port.notes: The Senate's official member portrait (EXIF Jan. 4, 2021, her first term; the file name carries her pre-2022 district number, 56) on her current member page (District 55). Posed, front-facing studio headshot on gray, warm smile showing teeth, eyes clearly visible. Face ~580px across. Long straight dark-brown hair with a side part, falling past the shoulders, slightly lighter auburn ends. Fair skin, rosy cheeks, soft even studio light. Small diamond stud earrings. No glasses. Magenta/plum blazer over a black top. No other candidates needed.

robert-f-kennedy-jr.publisher: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, via Wikimedia Commons
robert-f-kennedy-jr.notes: Robert F. Kennedy Jr., U.S. Secretary of Health and Human Services. His official HHS Secretary portrait (Feb 21, 2025; Commons credits HHS / his official Facebook), full size 1680x1680 kept as photos/robert-f-kennedy-jr.full.jpg; photos/robert-f-kennedy-jr.jpg is a head-and-shoulders crop (box 227,70,1452,1575), face ~700px across. Posed, front-facing, closed-mouth faint smile (corners just lifted), steady gaze; no open-smile official portrait exists, so draw the expression as the photo has it, not grimmer. Thick light silver-gray hair, short, brushed up and back, receding slightly at the temples; light blue eyes; no glasses; clean-shaven; deeply tanned, weathered skin with strong forehead and cheek lines (he was 71), lit by soft studio light from the front-left. Navy pinstripe suit, white button-down shirt, narrow navy tie with a small pin; US flag and HHS flag behind (drop them). hhs.gov returns Akamai 'Access Denied' to our agent (robots.txt included), so the Commons copy was used. Considered: Commons File:RFK_Jr._Portrait_(cropped).jpg (White House photo by Joyce Boghosian, Feb 13 2025, same closed-mouth expression, outdoors on a colonnade); the studio portrait is the better-lit official one.

ann-wagner.publisher: Office of U.S. Rep. Ann Wagner
ann-wagner.notes: Ann Wagner, U.S. Representative, Missouri's 2nd District. Her current official House headshot, shown on the About page of wagner.house.gov (file wagner-headshot-2026.jpg, original 3000x4500; the same photo the House Clerk has used since the 118th Congress, Nov 2022). Full file kept as photos/ann-wagner.full.jpg; photos/ann-wagner.jpg is a head-and-shoulders crop (box 0,113,3000,3603), face ~1350px across. Posed, front-facing, gentle closed-lip smile with red lipstick, eyes clear (smoky eye makeup). Shoulder-length honey-blonde hair with lighter blonde highlights, side-swept bangs, flipped slightly at the ends; no glasses; fair skin with soft, even studio light. Royal-blue collarless jacket and top, pearl-and-dark-bead necklace, pearl stud earrings, House member pin; flat blue backdrop (drop it). Alternatives with an open smile, rejected as older: the bioguide 450x550 (her 2013 portrait, broad toothy smile, kept as photos/ann-wagner.bioguide.jpg) and Commons File:Ann_Wagner_Headshot_(002).jpg (official House photo, Mar 2018, broad smile but three-quarter length with her face only ~300px).

mark-peake.publisher: Wikimedia Commons (Ashleylyh22; photo by Andrea P. Barrios)
mark-peake.notes: Commons file described as "Mark J. Peake, VA State Senator, 8th Senate District", own work of uploader Ashleylyh22, CC BY 4.0; EXIF: Canon 5D Mark IV, Apr 13 2023, artist Andrea P. Barrios. Thick white hair, side-parted and swept back with a little lift (a few flyaway strands on top); blue eyes; fair skin with a ruddy/pink tone and some lines; clean-shaven; bright, slightly warm light. Navy suit, white shirt, burgundy tie with navy and white stripes. Face ~900px across. Rejected: the live Senate member photo (member_photos/Peake8, id S105) is a newer studio headshot on a mottled gray backdrop with a similar smile, but only 262x269 (face ~110px); the large Senate copy in the Wayback Machine (Peake8.jpg, Feb 2024 capture, 1500x2099) is an older 2017 studio portrait (EXIF Feb 2017), so the 2023 Commons portrait is preferred as the more recent look. anne-milgram.notes: Anne Milgram, Administrator of the DEA (2021-2025). Rejected: Commons File:Anne_Milgram_official_DEA_photo.jpg (2021, 440x658, three-quarter length, face only ~100px; same green dress).

jackson-baynard.notes: Official portrait (alt "Portrait of Jackson Baynard", file dated May 2026) on his Henrico County Deputy County Manager for Public Safety page (former Henrico fire chief). eric-english.notes: Official 2024 Class A portrait (alt "Official Portrait of Chief Eric D. English. Henrico County Police Division's Chief of Police") on the Henrico Chief of Police page; original file is 2400x3000 half-length, kept as photos/eric-english.full.jpg, and photos/eric-english.jpg is a 1840x2000 head-and-shoulders crop. Posed professional headshot, slight three-quarter turn to her right, eyes to camera, smile showing teeth. Shoulder-length brown hair with a side part, dark rectangular green-framed glasses, large gold hoop earrings, fair skin, soft even light. Black blazer over an emerald-green top; abstract black-and-white artwork behind. Small file: face only ~130px across, draw from an upscale. No larger copy found: Commons has nothing; RVANews (her 2020 campaign launch as Kristen Larson) is behind a Cloudflare challenge and Ballotpedia returns a bot check (neither bypassed).
